note: The machine-readable step list. S2's gate divides by step_count, so the count lives here and not only in prose. Every step carries a named gate metric; `not_implemented` is a valid state, a blank metric is not. `required` marks the five steps without which there is nothing to show the candidate; every other step is offered and may be declined or deferred without blocking. S12: every step also carries `accepts_candidate_free_text` — whether that step's protocol puts free text about the candidate in front of a writer at all; `null` means undeclared and is caught by integral.profile_capture's own gate, never silently treated as false.

phases.first_run: Steps 0-6. Run once, in order, the first time a candidate uses the tool. Re-entered later by revision or by a freshness trigger, never repeated wholesale.
phases.loop: Steps 7-10. The recurring cycle the candidate lives in once a profile exists.
phases.per_opportunity: Steps 11-12. Run per offer the candidate pursues, any number of times, in parallel across offers.

steps.name: Identify
steps.goal: Know whose tree we are in, and where they left off, before anything is read or written.
steps.visible_output: A greeting that names the candidate, the date of their last activity, and where they stopped.

steps.name: Intake
steps.goal: Get the CV that exists into the store, or build the same store by conversation with someone who has none. No document is produced here.
steps.visible_output: A readable profile of their working life they can correct, with every fact showing where it came from.

steps.name: Constraints
steps.goal: Settle the facts that filter — residence, currency, permits, languages, hours, pay floor, mobility, cross-border — by confirming what the CV already implied and asking only for what it could not.
steps.visible_output: A constraints summary the candidate corrects in place, with anything still unknown listed as unknown.

steps.name: History
steps.goal: The last job and the ones before it: what they did, what went well, what did not, and why they left.
steps.visible_output: A story bank of episodes, each one readable, each one linked to what it evidences.

steps.name: Traits
steps.goal: Score the traits the accumulated evidence can support, and ask only about the ones it cannot.
steps.visible_output: A trait profile showing, per trait, the score or `insufficient`, and the episodes behind it.

steps.name: Reactions
steps.goal: Show real ads and real ad fragments and capture what the candidate makes of them — what repels, what attracts, how an employer's way of asking lands.
steps.visible_output: The candidate's own words against each stimulus, and the first sight of what the tool inferred from them.

steps.name: Preferences
steps.goal: Turn reactions and forced choices into weights the ranking can use, expressed in salary-equivalent terms.
steps.visible_output: What each dimension is worth to them per month, in the candidate's own currency, ordered — a list they can argue with.

steps.name: Sourcing
steps.goal: Bring offers in from sources worth using, deduped against everything ever seen, with the stale ones retired and the reach of the search established.
steps.visible_output: A count of what arrived, what was a duplicate, and what expired since last time.

steps.name: Understanding
steps.goal: Extract dimension values and the verbatim spans evidencing them from every new offer.
steps.visible_output: Per offer, what the ad was found to say — and what it did not say, which is not the same as saying no.

steps.name: Ranking
steps.goal: Order the live offers and present every position legibly, in the candidate's own terms.
steps.visible_output: A ranked list where each entry cites the words in the ad that moved it, and what it cost or gained per month.

steps.name: Feedback
steps.goal: Capture what the candidate thinks of the offers in front of them, and show the ranking move because of it.
steps.visible_output: A re-ordered list, and a plain statement of which position changed and which sentence they said caused it.

steps.name: Application
steps.goal: Produce a CV and a letter targeted at one offer, drawn only from what the store already holds.
steps.visible_output: The two documents, per offer, versioned so an earlier one that was actually sent is never overwritten.

steps.name: Interview
steps.goal: Prepare the candidate for the interview, then record what actually happened and turn it into the next preparation.
steps.visible_output: Beforehand, what to rehearse and what to expect; afterwards, the questions they were asked and what they wish they had said.
